mapper.sql: c.id AS id, c.public_id AS publicId, c.post_id AS postId, p.public_id AS postPublicId, p.title AS postTitle, p.status AS postStatus, c.applicant_id AS applicantId, c.status AS status, c.message AS message, c.contact AS contact, c.evidence_file_id AS evidenceFileId, c.confirmed_at AS confirmedAt, c.completed_at AS completedAt, c.canceled_at AS canceledAt, c.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT , p.user_id AS ownerId, o.public_id AS ownerPublicId, o.real_name AS ownerName, a.public_id AS applicantPublicId, a.real_name AS applicantName FROM claim c JOIN item_post p ON p.id = c.post_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN sys_user o ON o.id = p.user_id JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = c.applicant_id WHERE c.applicant_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT , p.user_id AS ownerId, o.public_id AS ownerPublicId, o.real_name AS ownerName, a.public_id AS applicantPublicId, a.real_name AS applicantName FROM claim c JOIN item_post p ON p.id = c.post_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN sys_user o ON o.id = p.user_id JOIN sys_user a ON a.id = c.applicant_id WHERE p.user_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 100
